key_facts: Family-friendly boat day from Puerto Banús, Marbella
Includes jet ski, snorkel gear, and paddleboard
Fleet options: Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax)
Licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and insurance covered
Departure from Puerto Banús, explore Costa del Sol coves
Ideal for families with kids aged 5+ (life jackets provided)

faq.q: What’s included in the family boat day with jet ski, snorkel & paddleboard?
faq.a: Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). The jet ski, snorkel masks, and paddleboard are provided at no extra cost. You just bring swimwear, sunscreen, and towels.

faq.q: Which boats are available for this family combo day?
faq.a: We recommend the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, up to 9 passengers) or the Azimut 39 (12.5m, up to 11 passengers). Both depart from Puerto Banús and are well-suited for families, with spacious decks and shaded areas. For larger groups, the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) includes a free jet ski and starts at €4,719 for 4 hours.

faq.q: How long is the charter and what are the prices?
faq.a: Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) cost €749 for 2 hours, €1,299 for 4 hours, €1,699 for 6 hours, and €2,299 for 8 hours. All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and VAT. The jet ski, snorkel, and paddleboard are included for any duration. Longer charters allow more time to explore coves and enjoy water toys.

faq.q: Can we bring our own food and drinks?
faq.a: Yes, you’re welcome to bring your own food and drinks. The boat is equipped with a cooler and ice. Our standard package already includes water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. If you want a full catered menu, let us know and we can arrange it at an extra cost.

faq.q: What’s the typical itinerary for a family boat day?
faq.a: Depart Puerto Banús, head east toward Cabopino or west toward Estepona. Popular stops include Cala del Faro, Cala Cortés, and the coves near Río Verde. You’ll anchor for swimming, snorkeling, paddleboarding, and jet skiing. The skipper will choose spots based on sea conditions and your preferences. Lunch can be taken at a beach club or on board.

faq.q: Is the jet ski safe for children?
faq.a: Yes, but children must be accompanied by an adult on the jet ski. Life jackets are provided for all ages. The skipper will give a safety briefing and supervise activities. We recommend the jet ski for kids aged 8 and above, though younger children can enjoy snorkeling and paddleboarding with adult supervision.

faq.q: What should we bring for the day?
faq.a: Bring swimwear, towels, sunscreen (reef-safe recommended), sunglasses, a hat, and a light jacket for the breeze. If you’re prone to seasickness, consider taking medication an hour before departure. We provide all water sports equipment, so no need to bring your own. A waterproof phone case is handy for photos.

faq.q: How do I book and what’s the cancellation policy?
faq.a: Book via WhatsApp or our website. A 50% deposit secures the date, with the balance due on the day. Cancellations made 48 hours before departure receive a full refund. Within 48 hours, the deposit is non-refundable unless we can rebook your slot. Weather-related cancellations are fully refundable.

data.body_html:
Looking for a Marbella family boat day with jet ski, snorkel & paddleboard? This all-in-one charter from Puerto Banús gives your family a full day on the water with water toys included. Prices start at €749 for 2 hours on an Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, with a licensed skipper, fuel, drinks, and snacks covered. No hidden costs — just show up and enjoy.

Why choose this family boat day combo?

Instead of renting a boat and then separately booking a jet ski or paddleboard, this package bundles everything. You get a modern motor yacht, a jet ski for the kids (or adults), snorkel masks, fins, and a paddleboard. The skipper handles navigation and safety, so parents can relax. The Costa del Sol’s calm coves — like Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés — are perfect for anchoring and playing in the water.

Which boats are available?

For families up to 11 people, we recommend the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax). Both depart from Puerto Banús and have spacious sundecks, a small cabin, and a fridge. If you have a larger group (up to 12), the Mangusta 80 (24m) includes a free jet ski and costs €4,719 for a minimum 4 hours. See our full fleet on the [boat rental Marbella](/experiences/) page.

Pricing and inclusions

DurationPrice (Astondoa 40 / Azimut 39)
2 hours€749
4 hours€1,299

8 hours€2,299

All prices include: licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and VAT (21%). Jet ski, snorkel gear, and paddleboard are provided free. No extra charges for cleaning or fuel.

Sample itinerary

Depart Puerto Banús at 10:00. Head west toward Estepona or east toward Cabopino. Anchor at a quiet cove — Río Verde, Cala del Faro, or Cala Cortés. Spend 1-2 hours snorkeling and paddleboarding. Then fire up the jet ski for 20-minute sessions per person (supervised). Lunch can be at a beach club like Ocean Club Marbella or a picnic on board. Return to port by 18:00. The skipper adapts the route to weather and your preferences.

What to bring

  • Swimwear and towels
  • Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 50+)
  • Sunglasses and hat
  • Light jacket or windbreaker
  • Waterproof phone case (optional)
  • Snacks or lunch (optional; we provide light snacks)

Safety and kids

Life jackets are provided for all ages, including children. The skipper gives a safety briefing before departure. Kids under 8 must be accompanied by an adult on the jet ski. Snorkeling and paddleboarding are safe in calm coves with adult supervision. The boat has shaded areas and a small cabin for naps. For more family-friendly options, see our [family boat rental Marbella](/family-boat-rental-marbella/) guide.

How to book

Book via WhatsApp or our website. A 50% deposit secures the date; balance due on the day. Cancellations 48+ hours before departure get a full refund. Within 48 hours, deposit is non-refundable unless we rebook. Weather cancellations are fully refundable. For other boats or custom durations, [contact us](/contact/) for a quote.
